**Finding: compliant (at fallback).**

Section 13.6.1 applies **Delaware** law — the playbook's accepted fallback (preferred is New York), so no redline is warranted. The dispute path (Senior Officer escalation → arbitration under Schedule 13.7.3, with IP validity/enforceability disputes carved out to courts under 13.7.2 and interim relief preserved under 13.7.5) shows no foreign law, no exclusive foreign venue, and nothing in walk-away territory.

Two sub-elements noted in the rationale rather than flagged:
- Section 13.6 has no affirmative exclusive-jurisdiction sentence; only 13.6.2 (service) refers to "any such court."
- The arbitration procedures and **seat are redacted** in Schedule 13.7.3 — worth confirming on diligence that the seat is in the U.S.; a foreign seat would reopen this rule as a deviation.
